content.text: {"affected_statement":"L6.2","objection_correct":"yes","established_elsewhere":"no","elsewhere_quote":null,"status_as_written":"not_established","repair_distance":"lemma","explanation":"Within Step 4, hypothesis (iii) would indeed imply that the Zorn-minimal transversal T belongs to C and is therefore finite. However, Claim 3.2 does not prove (iii) for an infinite T: it writes π(T) and treats it as an integer, which is valid only for finite T. Zorn’s lemma in Step 4(a) does not itself ensure finiteness. Thus full self-duality—and consequently the finiteness/large-prime-erasure mechanism required by L6.2—remains unproved. A separate lemma handling arbitrary minimal transversals is required."}
